children: Rocket Pharmaceuticals entered a senior secured term loan facility of up to $150 million arranged by Hercules Capital, providing immediate and milestone-based access to funding across five tranches. The agreement includes a $35 million initial draw, interest-only periods that may extend with clinical and regulatory milestones, and maturity in 2030, extendable to 2031. In connection with the financing, Rocket issued lender warrants for up to 1,755,853 shares at $2.99, exercisable proportionally with loan drawdowns; 409,699 warrants became exercisable at closing. The transactions are intended to bolster liquidity to advance the company’s pipeline, including RP-A501 for Danon Disease.
Agreement 1: Rocket Pharmaceuticals Secures Up to $150 Million Hercules-Backed Term Loan With Multi-Tranche Structure
: Senior secured multi-tranche term loan facility (up to $150 million)
: Hercules Capital, as Agent, and other lenders
: Enhance liquidity for programs including RP-A501 and operations
Agreement 2: Rocket Pharmaceuticals Issues Warrants for Up to 1.76M Shares at $2.99 to Lenders
: Equity warrant issuance tied to loan drawdowns
: Consideration to secure and align financing
